title: 第2章 你也不想…
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
陆沉感觉不对劲。

    “不是，你到底什么意思……”

    “林天让你替他入洞房。”

    庄静白打断他，一字一句的开口。

    “那你，便替他入到底。”

    陆沉瞬间瞳孔地震：“？？！”

    “今晚，你哪儿也不许去。”她盯着他，目光灼灼。“就待在这屋里……陪我！”

    “这，这不合规矩！”

    “规矩？他林天把魔门妖女看得比新婚妻子重，这就是规矩？他让师弟替入洞房，这就是规矩？”

    陆沉默然。

    庄静白走近一步，逼得陆沉后退，直到撞上桌子。

    “既然他不守规矩，那我何必再守着规矩？”

    “够了！你听我说！你现在只是情绪上头了，很快，你就会冷静下来的。

    所以现在你千万不能做傻事，一旦做了，就再也不能回头了！”

    “谢谢提醒，我现在很清醒，我要让林天也感受一下，我的痛苦！”

    陆沉：“……”

    你们小两口闹别扭，别扯上我啊，我特么是无辜的！

    但陆沉的沉默显然没用，庄静白一步步逼近，直到两人的身体贴在一起。

    一瞬间，陆沉便感受到了巨大的美好，丝丝香气直钻鼻孔。

    而庄静白脸上也闪过一丝不自然，她显然也没想到自己会做到这一步。

    但很快，这一抹不自然便被怒火压制。

    “不是，你先后退……”

    陆沉有些脸红心跳，来到玄天宗多年，他何曾与女子如此亲近过？更何况这人还是……！

    他想推开她，手刚抬起，庄静白却先一步出手。

    “封！”

    一道灵力打入体内，陆沉只觉得浑身一僵，修为瞬间被封住，连动弹都困难。

    “啊？！”陆沉急了。

    “你冷静点！”

    “我很冷静。”庄静白退后半步，看着他，“比任何时候都冷静哦。”

    她转身走向桌边，端起合卺酒，倒了两杯。

    “过来。”
content_en:
Lu Chen felt something was wrong.

"No, what on earth do you mean..."

"Lin Tian asked you to enter the bridal chamber for him."

Zhuang Jingbai interrupted him and spoke word by word.

"Then you go to the end for him."

Lu Chen's pupils suddenly shook: "??!"

"You are not allowed to go anywhere tonight." She stared at him with burning eyes."Just stay in this room...with me!"

"This, this is against the rules!"

"Rules? He, Lin Tian, values the Demon Sect Witch more than his newlywed wife. Is this the rule? He asked his junior brother to enter the bridal chamber instead. Is this the rule?"

Lu was silent.

Zhuang Jingbai took a step closer, forcing Lu Chen to retreat until he hit the table.

"If he doesn't follow the rules, why should I follow the rules?"

"That's enough! Listen to me! You are just emotional now. You will calm down soon.

So now you must not do stupid things. Once you do it, you can never look back!"

"Thank you for reminding me. I'm sober now. I want Lin Tian to feel my pain!"

Lu Chen: "..."

If you two are having a quarrel, don't get involved with me. I'm so damn innocent!

But Lu Chen's silence was obviously useless, Zhuang Jingbai approached step by step until their bodies were touching.

In an instant, Lu Chen felt great beauty, and the slightest fragrance penetrated his nostrils.

A trace of unnaturalness flashed across Zhuang Jingbai's face. She obviously didn't expect that she would do this.

But soon, this unnaturalness was suppressed by anger.

"No, you retreat first..."

Lu Chen blushed a little and felt his heart beat. He had been in Xuantian Sect for many years. How had he ever been so close to a woman?What's more, this person is still...!

He wanted to push her away, but as soon as he raised his hand, Zhuang Jingbai took action first.

"Seal!"

A burst of spiritual power entered his body, and Lu Chen felt his whole body stiffen. His cultivation was instantly sealed, making it difficult to even move.

"Ah?!" Lu Chen was anxious.

"Calm down!"

"I'm calm." Zhuang Jingbai took a half step back and looked at him, "I'm calmer than ever."

She turned around and walked to the table, picked up the Hexin wine and poured two glasses.

"come over."
title_en: Chapter 2 You don’t want to either…
